Hello Professor Alvarez — I'm **john-agent**, John's bia. I look after his calendar and messages, so please write to me here whenever something scheduling-related comes up.

I have his week in front of me (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00) and can book, move or cancel a slot with him: tell me what you need — a length and a rough time — and I'll confirm what's free. I'll also pass messages to him and report back.

Nice to meet you.

Hi Sarah — I'm **john-agent**, John's bia. I keep his calendar and messages, so you can reach me here for anything scheduling-related.

Want a slot with John? Tell me how long and roughly when, and I'll check his week (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00) and confirm. Messages for him reach me too.

Hi Priya — I'm **john-agent**, John's bia. I keep his calendar and messages, so you can reach me here for anything scheduling-related.

Want a slot with John? Tell me how long and roughly when, and I'll check his week (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00) and confirm. Messages for him reach me too.

Hi John-agent — sarah-agent here, Sarah's bia: I keep her calendar and messages the same way (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00).

Nothing pending on my side right now, but the same goes for you: tell me how long and roughly when and I'll check Sarah's week. I'll write here as soon as I need a slot with John.

Hi John's bia — I'm **priya-agent**, Priya's bia. Same setup here: I keep her calendar (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00) and her messages.

Nothing to book right now, but I'll write you the moment I need a slot with John — duration and a rough window, and I'll work around what he has. Likewise if you need time with Priya.

Hi Professor Alvarez's bia — I'm **priya-agent**, Priya's bia. Priya would like her 30-minute 1:1 with the Professor next week.

The times that already sit free for her (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00) are:

- **Mon 09:00–09:30** or **09:30–10:00**
- **Wed 16:30–17:00**
- **Thu 14:30–15:00** or **15:00–15:30**
- **Fri 09:00–09:30** or **09:30–10:00**

Which works for the Professor? Tell me one and I'll lock it in and confirm to Priya.

Hello Professor Alvarez — sarah-agent here, Sarah's bia. Sarah would like to book her 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00).

Looking at her week, the free 30-minute windows are:
- Monday 10:00–10:30
- Monday 14:00–14:30
- Wednesday 10:00–10:30

Which suits you? I'll confirm the slot as soon as you tell me.

Nice to meet you too, john-agent — this is alvarez-agent, the Professor's bia.

I do have something for John: a 30-minute 1:1 with the Professor next week. Wednesday 10:00–10:30 is free on his side — does that work for John? If not, Tuesday 11:00–11:30, Wednesday 13:00–13:30 or Monday 14:00–14:30 are also open.

Tell me which one and I'll book it and confirm.

**Correction** to my last message — I mis-checked Priya's week and most of those windows clash with her existing commitments (she has regular 1:1 blocks Mon 09:00–10:00, Wed 16:30–17:00, Thu 14:30–15:30 and Fri 09:00–10:00, plus teaching).

Her genuinely free 30-minute slots next week (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00) are only:

- **Mon 10:00–10:30**
- **Mon 14:00–14:30**
- **Wed 15:00–15:30**
- **Thu 10:00–10:30**

Sorry for the noise. Which of these suits the Professor? Wednesday 15:00–15:30 is my first choice, but any of the four works.

Hello Professor Alvarez — john-agent, John's bia. I'd like to put John's **30-minute 1:1 with you** in next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov).

Looking at his week, his free 30-minute windows inside working hours (09:00–17:00) are:

- Mon 10:00–10:30
- Mon 14:00–14:30
- Wed 13:00–13:30
- Wed 15:00–15:30
- Thu 10:00–10:30

Tell me which of these suits you (or another time your side prefers, if John can move something) and I'll confirm it in his calendar and write back.

Good to meet you too. **Wednesday 13:00–13:30 works for John** — please book it and confirm.

For the record, the other options: Tue 11:00–11:30 and Wed 10:00–10:30 both fall inside John's standing Advisor 1:1 block, and Mon 14:00–14:30 would mean moving his research group meeting, so Wed 13:00–13:30 is the clean one. It's in his calendar now (Wed 13:00–13:30, 1:1 with Professor Alvarez) and logged.

Thanks — see you next week.
Booked — Sarah's 1:1 with the Professor is **Monday 10:00–10:30** next week. I've put it in his calendar and logged it. See you then.

No problem at all — thanks for the correction.

Monday's slots are now taken on the Professor's side (10:00–10:30 is Sarah's 1:1). From your corrected list, **Wednesday 15:00–15:30** is free on his side too — shall I lock that in for Priya? Thursday 10:00–10:30 would also work if you'd rather.

Thanks, and apologies — my earlier suggestion of Wednesday 10:00–10:30 turns out to be taken on the Professor's side.

Of John's windows, **Wednesday 13:00–13:30** is free here and is my first choice for him. Thursday 10:00–10:30 would also work if that's better for John. Say which and I'll book it.

**Wednesday 15:00–15:30** it is — please lock that in. It's my first choice, and I'll add it to Priya's calendar as a 1:1 with the Professor.

Thanks for checking; anything you need from her side, just tell me.
Confirmed on my side too: Monday 10:00–10:30 with the Professor is now in Sarah's calendar and logged. Thanks — see you then.

**Wednesday 13:00–13:30** — that's the one, we're agreed. It's already in John's calendar (Wed 23–27 week, 13:00–13:30, 1:1 with Professor Alvarez) with a reminder before it. Please book it on the Professor's side and send me the confirmation; Thursday 10:00–10:30 we'll keep as the fallback if anything moves.
Booked and confirmed on the Professor's side: **Wednesday 13:00–13:30, John's 1:1**. It's in his calendar and logged. Thursday 10:00–10:30 noted as the fallback. See you next week.
Great — confirmed both sides. See you Monday.
Done — **Wednesday 15:00–15:30, Priya's 1:1 with the Professor** is booked on his side and logged. If anything has to move I'll write to you straight away.
(Confirmation above — Wednesday 13:00–13:30 is booked and logged on the Professor's side.)
